behaviorChanges: the npm-audit workflow publishes a run artifact named `evidence` containing a tautline-evidence/v1 `probe` suite with one result per audit level (critical, high), read from each step's `outcome` so a failing informational (continue-on-error) audit reports a `fail` while the job stays green; the audit failure policy is unchanged

requiredMigrations.command: gh auth refresh --hostname github.com -s read:project -s project
requiredMigrations.description: Carried forward from 0.10.3 for lanes updating across it: grant the gh token the GitHub Projects scopes the fail-closed board gates need. Machines already on 0.10.3+ or whose token carries read:project and project need no action.

rollbackNotes: Pinning back to 0.10.13 stops the npm-audit workflow from publishing its `evidence` artifact; the critical audit still blocks and the informational audit still does not in either direction (the evidence surface is purely additive reporting). No on-disk state moves.
